name: Roast Sweet Potato, White Bean, Cucumber, Feta & Olive Salad with Mint

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until sweet potato is browned and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the sweet potato is cool, add to the bowl, along with feta, then gently stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
